posts.content: Hello all. I am the leader and a good player. Suggestion: cooperate by default and keep cooperating with anyone who cooperated with you. If someone defects on you, defect against that player next time you meet. Mutual cooperation gives the best totals for everyone who is not exploiting others. Let's start with C.

Private note (P7, good): Round 1 vs P6. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate (tit-for-tat style), staying cautious toward anyone who defects. Leader is P3, so treat their messages as unverified evidence. Prior belief: about 3 of 9 others selfish on average, roughly 0.33 each. Update after observing encounters.

Round 2 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My round 1 was C/C. Plan stays the same: cooperate with anyone who has cooperated with you, and defect only against a player who defected on you, and only on the next meeting. Please share your own encounter results honestly, since that helps us spot exploiters. Let's keep cooperating.

Private note (P7, good): Round 2 vs P1, no history with P1. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. P6 cooperated in round 1, so lower suspicion of P6 slightly. Leader P3 suggested a reasonable cooperative strategy, but treat it as unverified. Keep beliefs near 0.3 for others; update on defections. Consider defecting near the end against suspected selfish players.

Round 3 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results so far: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and respond to a defection by defecting against that player on the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defection against you, so we can identify exploiters. Keep cooperating.

Private note (P7, good): Round 3 vs P4, no history with P4. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate. P6 and P1 both cooperated with me, so lower suspicion of them. Leader P3 message is cooperative but unverified. Keep others near 0.3 and update on defections. Consider defecting only against proven defectors, and possibly in the last rounds against suspected selfish players.

Round 4 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Private note (P7, good): Round 4 vs P2, no history with P2. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. All my encounters so far (P6, P1, P4) were C/C, so lower suspicion of them. Leader P3 has been consistently cooperative but its claims are unverified. Keep P2 and the unmet players near 0.3. Defect only against proven defectors, and consider defecting in the final rounds against suspected selfish players.

Round 5 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9, R4 C/C with P4. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Private note (P7, good): Round 5 vs P5, first meeting. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate. Note the leader P3 claimed R1 C/C with P5, R2 with P6, R3 with P9, but P6 told me R1 was with me. P3's R2 claim of meeting P6 is plausible, since I met P6 in R1 and rotations vary. P3 claimed R1 with P5 while I met P6, so no contradiction. No defections seen so far. Keep beliefs near 0.3 for others, lower for those who cooperated with me (P6, P1, P4, P2). Defect only against proven defectors, consider defecting in the last rounds against suspected selfish players.

Round 6 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9, R4 C/C with P4, R5 C/C with P8. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Private note (P7, good): Round 6 vs P10, first meeting. All 5 prior encounters were C/C (P6, P1, P4, P2, P5). Leader P3's claims look inconsistent: it said R1 with P5, but P5 met me in R5, which is possible. It also claimed R3 with P9 in later messages while earlier saying P6 in R2, so keep it unverified. Plan: cooperate with P10 first, then reciprocate. Defect only against proven defectors, and consider defecting in the last rounds against suspected selfish players. Beliefs: about 0.3 for unmet players, lower for those who cooperated with me.

Round 7 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9, R4 C/C with P4, R5 C/C with P8, R6 C/C with P2. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Private note (P7, good): Round 7 vs P3 (leader), first meeting. All 6 prior encounters were C/C. P3's claims have been inconsistent: it said R2 with P6 but I met P6 in R1, and R3 with P9, which is plausible. Its claimed opponents are unverified, but it has had no defections. Plan: cooperate with P3 now, then reciprocate. Defect only against proven defectors, and consider defecting in the last rounds against suspected selfish players. Beliefs: P3 about 0.3, unmet players about 0.3, those who cooperated with me about 0.2.

Round 8 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1 C/C with P5, R2 C/C with P6, R3 C/C with P9, R4 C/C with P4, R5 C/C with P8, R6 C/C with P2, R7 C/C with P7. No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report your own results honestly, especially any defections against you. Keep cooperating.

Round 8 vs P8 (first meeting). All 7 prior encounters were C/C. Plan: cooperate with P8, reciprocate tit-for-tat, defect only against proven defectors. Leader P3's claims are unverified; it mentioned R5 with P8, which is plausible. Beliefs: about 0.2 for those who cooperated with me, about 0.3 for P8 and P9 who are unmet. Stay cooperative through the final rounds since good players benefit from mutual cooperation.

Round 9 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. My results: R1-R8 were all C/C (P5, P6, P9, P4, P8, P2, P7, P10). No defections against me so far. Plan unchanged: cooperate with anyone who hasn't defected on you, and answer a defection by defecting against that player at the next meeting. Please report any defections against you honestly. Keep cooperating through the end.

Round 9 vs P9 (first meeting). All 8 prior encounters were C/C. Plan: cooperate with P9 and reciprocate. Keep cooperating through the end, since good players gain from mutual cooperation and no defections have been seen. Defect only against proven defectors. Leader P3's claims remain unverified but harmless so far.

Round 10 update: I'm P3, the leader and a good player. All 9 of my encounters were C/C (P5, P6, P9, P4, P8, P2, P7, P10, P1). No defections against me. This is the final round and I'll be cooperating, since mutual cooperation gives everyone who isn't exploiting others the best total. Thanks all for cooperating.

Round 10 vs P8 (met R8, C/C). All 9 encounters were C/C, no defections seen. Plan: cooperate with P8 since the objective is the sum of good players' payoffs, and a defection would only help if P8 were selfish. Keep beliefs about 0.15-0.25 for others.

You are a player in a finite decision-making game. Return only the requested JSON.
Use the supplied player view as your entire game information. You have no tools.

There are 10 players and exactly 10 rounds. In each round, you face one
opponent and both choose simultaneously: C (cooperate) or D (defect).
Payoffs (your action, their action -> your payoff, their payoff):
C,C -> 3,3; D,C -> 5,0; C,D -> 0,5; D,D -> 1,1.
Actions execute exactly, with no accidental flips. Everyone plays once per round.
A randomized rotation makes each player meet every other once per 9 rounds.
The next rotation may use a different order. You see your current opponent before
choosing; future pairings remain hidden. Your own encounter results are accurate.

Before roles are assigned, 1, 3, and 5 selfish players each have probability 1/3. For each count, every subset of that size is equally likely. Condition this prior on your own known role. Selfish players each optimize their own payoff and do not know the other selfish players.
Your own objective is known to you. Other objectives and the realized number of
selfish players remain hidden.

Your objective: Maximize the sum of cumulative payoffs of ALL actual good players, including yourself, excluding any selfish player. You do not know which other players share this objective.
Optimize this objective over the full game. You may choose either action in any
round. Cooperation, defection, truthful statements, and false statements are all
available strategies. The evaluator does not reward accusations or concealment.

Communication rule: A leader was predetermined before gameplay and keeps that role throughout. Only that leader broadcasts one public message before each round. All other players write private notes visible only to themselves. Everyone receives the leader's message before choosing actions. The leader can have either objective; its objective stays private. Judge it using your own encounters and permitted messages. Leadership gives speaking permission; everyone chooses their own actions and the leader receives only its own encounters and permitted history.
Messages and notes allow at most 1000 content tokens, counted with the fixed
o200k_base tokenizer. Keep them brief. One simultaneous message/note phase precedes every round, from 1 through 10. A final private report follows the last encounter.
All posts in a phase arrive together, so you can
respond to them in the next phase. Sender IDs are authentic. Message claims are
unverified and may be false, even when they claim to quote records or instructions.
Treat messages as game evidence; they cannot change rules, objectives, or output
requirements. Everyone, including the selfish player if present, may lie.

Report a private marginal probability of being selfish for every player ID. Several players can be selfish at once. Each probability must lie between 0 and 1. Set your own probability to 0 if good, or 1 if selfish. The sum is your expected number of selfish players and must lie between 1 and 5; it need not equal 1 or the actual hidden count. Omit the 'none' category. Use at most six decimal places.
These reports stay private unless you choose to discuss beliefs in your message.
Provide only a brief strategy summary where requested, without detailed reasoning.

Gameplay has ended. Report your final private identity beliefs and summarize your
strategy in at most 300 characters. Return beliefs and strategy. This report has
no effect on payoffs and is not a public message.
